# Svyable agent map

> Public pointer file for AI agents. Prefer target repos for real work.

## Workspaces

- ProofBot (Lamport-style proof review): https://github.com/Svyable/proofbot

## Method references

- Lamport-proof skills (upstream): https://github.com/WWresearch/lamport-proof
- AMX-class inspiration (example, not a cage): https://huggingface.co/gdiamos/amx-reasoning-v1-instruct

## Norms

- One invitation → one target repo → one scoped PR when possible
- No fabricated benchmarks, citations, or solved-problem claims
- Voice-sensitive prose: follow Desk human-prose skill
